note: ORPHAN Pro 30:7 — two things I ask of you; deny them not to me before I die.

dims.v: humble request — asking two things of God before death
the asking of two things of God before death — Agur's humble, earnest petition, a prayer that knows its own need and lays two specific requests before God with reverent urgency
the humble, self-knowing prayer that asks God for what the soul truly needs

shaal (ask/request) — 'two things I ASK of you; deny them not to me before I die' (30:7); Agur prays with humble, urgent specificity. His is a prayer that knows its own weakness and asks God to guard it — the model of self-knowing petition (30:8-9).
